summary: Verified both shipped changes end-to-end. CHANGE 1 (PDF disclaimer): unit-built PDFs from _build_pdf, render_matrix_pdf and live /api/decisions/{id}/mpps-action-plan-pdf all contain 'Disclaimer:' and 'JELCOS AI is not responsible' substrings; brand footer 'JELCOS AI' / '© JELCOS AI' / 'Best Wishes' still appears AFTER disclaimer (order verified by index comparison). CHANGE 2 (awareness→consciousness): /api/assessment/questions returns 3 consciousness Qs and zero 'awareness'; POST /api/assessment with consciousness=5/others=3 returns dominant_mode='consciousness' and mode_scores.consciousness=5.0 with no legacy keys; /api/assessment/history shows migrated records (no awareness keys). Frontend UI verified after fixing a build-blocking SyntaxError in (tabs)/index.tsx (leftover garbage after final `});`): Home shows 'Consciousness' row + CTA 'Take Quiz & Know your Decision Style'; Profile shows 'Your Predominant Decision Mode' + dominant 'Consciousness' card + Mode Breakdown rows with '%' suffix and one decimal (e.g. 60.0%). The 'Awareness' string seen on Home is the §8 'Reflection & Awareness' section header (explicitly NOT to be flagged per request). 7/7 backend tests pass; 1 regression test SKIPPED because admin lacks L1 quota for dezider PDF download (entitlement gate returns 402, not a regression).

rca_of_issue: Build-blocking issue RCA: /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/index.tsx ended with the correct `});` at line 1397 followed by stray fragment `ginTop: 2,\n  },\n});` on lines 1398-1400 — likely a botched merge / partial paste from the recent profile.tsx edit. Babel parser failed at 1399:2 ('Unexpected token'), Metro returned 500 for the bundle, the SPA shell could not boot, and every screen rendered blank. Mitigation applied: removed the stray 3 lines; Metro recompiled successfully (1622 modules) and the app loaded normally. Going forward, run `tsc --noEmit` or `expo export --platform web` before shipping front-end edits to catch parse failures pre-deploy.
